title: Protocol for Subtomogram Averaging of Helical Filaments in Cryo-Electron Tomography
author: Zhang, Mahamid
materials: EM map for isolated nucleocapsids, majority class
EM map for isolated nucleocapsids, minority class
Model for isolated nucleocapsids, majority class

steps.title: Isolate nucleocapsids from lysate
steps.instruction: Clear HeLa cell lysate and pellet nucleocapsids, then straighten them with heparin.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge lysate at 500 × g, 4 °C for 5 min to remove debris.
Centrifuge supernatant at 13,000 × g, 4 °C for 20 min to pellet nucleocapsids.
Resuspend pellet and incubate with 50 µg/mL heparin for 1–2 h to induce straightening.

steps.title: Plunge‑freeze nucleocapsid grids
steps.instruction: Prepare glow‑discharged grids, add gold fiducials, blot and vitrify the sample, then store in liquid nitrogen.

substeps.instruction: Glow‑discharge holey Quantifoil R2/1 grids with 2 nm continuous carbon (Cu 200 mesh) on the front side for 45 s using a PELCO easiGlow (0.39 mBar, 15 mA, air).
Pellet 10‑nm Protein‑A colloidal gold fiducials at 13,000 × g, 4 °C for 20 min; remove supernatant and resuspend the pellet in a 3:1 volume ratio of the nucleocapsid buffer.
Mix 1.5 µL of the 3× concentrated fiducials with 3 µL nucleocapsid suspension per grid (optional; alignment may rely on patch tracking).
Set Vitrobot Mark IV to 22 °C, 100 % humidity, blot force 0, blot time 2 s, drain time 2 s, blotting both sides with filter paper.
Plunge‑freeze the grids, then store them sealed in liquid nitrogen until imaging.
